remarks: Welcome to Unit #4C at Riverturn, a attractive private community in the desirable Turn of River neighborhood. This impressive and newly refreshed 2 BR/2.5 BTH townhome boasts an incredible layout with an endless supply of space and storage, freshly painted with newly installed as well as refinished hardwood floors from head to toe. The main level opens with a bright, sunny EIK with new refrigerator, new range and new microwave, huge living room with electric fireplace and exterior balcony, dining area and powder room. Located on the second level is the huge ensuite primary bedroom with sky high ceilings, luxurious bath, huge skylight and picture window with closets to match, a second large bedroom with its own large closet and a jack-and-jill bath with an entrance from the hall. Third level houses the skylit alcove, perfect for home office, playroom or respite with even more place for storage. Lower level has additional room, great for media setup or an extra den, laundry and garage access. This unit is located by far in one of the best retail corridors of Stamford, with High Ridge Shopping Plaza and its many shops and restaurants, Orange Theory, Starbucks, Trader Joes and an upcoming Barnes and Noble bookstore along with countless other stores along High Ridge Road at your fingertips. Stamford Museum and Nature Center, Harry Bennett Library, Merritt exit 35 entrance/exit nearby, downtown Stamford and Metro North just minutes away. New roof job starting mid May
